title: Balloons Over America

services.name: Balloon Rides
services.desc: On our hot air balloon rides, you will leisurely float over the picturesque countryside, taking in the beautiful scenery and the peacefulness that comes from drifting among the clouds. Visit our photo gallery to view our three beautiful balloons: On The Fly, Bliss, and Carnival. When you book with us you will be a passenger on one of these colorful vessels! Hot air balloon flights usually stretch from about 5 to 10 miles depending on factors like fuel, wind speed, and landing sights. Our flights will float about 2000 feet from the ground to afford you the best, up-close views of the countryside below, skimming the treetops.
